23static inline float blamp0(float x) {
24 return 1.0f / 3.0f * x * x * x;
25}
26
27static inline float blamp1(float x) {
28 x = x - 1.0f;
29 return -1.0f / 3.0f * x * x * x;
30}
31
32//PolyBLEP Waveform generator ported from the Jesusonic code by Tale
33//http://www.taletn.com/reaper/mono_synth/
34//from Martin Finke's githubb polyblep project
35// Derived from blep().
36static inline float blamp(float t, float dt) {
37 if (t < dt) {
38 t = (t / dt) - 1.0f;
39 return -1.0f / 3.0f * t * t * t;
40 } else if (t > (1.0f - dt)) {
41 t = (t - 1.0f) / dt + 1.0f;
42 return 1.0f / 3.0f * t * t * t;
43 } else {
44 return 0.0f;
45 }
46}

75//need to check bounds and wrap table properly to allow through-zero FM
76Lfloat tCycle_tick(tCycle const c)
77{
78 uint32_t tempFrac;
79 uint32_t idx;
80 Lfloat samp0;
81 Lfloat samp1;
82
83 // Phasor increment
84 c->phase += c->inc;
85 // Wavetable synthesis
86 idx = c->phase >> 21; //11 bit table
87 tempFrac = (c->phase & 2097151u); //(2^21 - 1) all the lower bits i.e. the remainder of a division by 2^21 (2097151 is the 21 bits after the 11 bits that represent the main index)
88
89 samp0 = __leaf_table_sinewave[idx];
90 idx = (idx + 1) & c->mask;
91 samp1 = __leaf_table_sinewave[idx];
92
93 return (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * ((Lfloat)tempFrac * 0.000000476837386f)); // 1/2097151
94}

98

100

103}

151Lfloat tTriangle_tick(const tTriangle c)
152{
153 uint32_t idx;
154 Lfloat frac;
155 Lfloat samp0;
156 Lfloat samp1;
157
158 // Phasor increment
159 c->phase += c->inc;
160 // Wavetable synthesis
161 idx = c->phase >> 21;
162 uint32_t idx2 = (idx + 1) & c->mask;
163 uint32_t tempFrac = (c->phase & 2097151);
164 frac = (Lfloat)tempFrac * 0.000000476837386f;// 1/2097151 (2097151 is the 21 bits after the 11 bits that represent the main index)
165
166 samp0 = __leaf_table_triangle[c->oct][idx];
167 samp1 = __leaf_table_triangle[c->oct][idx2];
168 Lfloat oct0 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
169
170 samp0 = __leaf_table_triangle[c->oct+1][idx];
171 samp1 = __leaf_table_triangle[c->oct+1][idx2];
172 Lfloat oct1 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
173
174 return oct0 + (oct1 - oct0) * c->w;
175}
176
177void tTriangle_setFreq(const tTriangle c, Lfloat freq)
178{
179 c->freq = freq;
180 c->inc = freq * c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32;
181
182 // abs for negative frequencies
183 c->w = fabsf(c->freq * (TRI_TABLE_SIZE * c->invSampleRate));
184
185 c->w = log2f_approx(c->w);//+ LEAF_SQRT2 - 1.0f; adding an offset here will shift our table selection upward, reducing aliasing but lower high freq fidelity. +1.0f should remove all aliasing
186 if (c->w < 0.0f) c->w = 0.0f;
187 c->oct = (int)c->w;
188 c->w -= c->oct;
189 if (c->oct >= 10) c->oct = 9;
190}
191
192void tTriangle_setPhase(const tTriangle c, Lfloat phase)
193{
194 int i = phase;
195 phase -= i;
196 c->phase = phase * TWO_TO_32;
197}
198
199void tTriangle_setSampleRate (const tTriangle c, Lfloat sr)
200{
201
202 c->invSampleRate = 1.0f/sr;
203 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = c->invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32;
204 tTriangle_setFreq(c, c->freq);
205}
206#endif // LEAF_INCLUDE_TRIANGLE_TABLE

398void tPBTriangle_initToPool (tPBTriangle* const osc, tMempool* const mp)
399{
400 _tMempool* m = *mp;
401 _tPBTriangle* c = *osc = (_tPBTriangle*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tPBTriangle), m);
402 c->mempool = m;
403 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
404
405 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
406 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = c->invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32;
407 c->inc = 0;
408 c->phase = 0;
409 c->width = (0.5f * TWO_TO_32);
410 c->oneMinusWidth = c->width;
411 c->freq = 0.0f;
412}

421#ifdef ITCMRAM
422 Lfloat __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tPBTriangle_tick (tPBTriangle* const osc)
423#else
424Lfloat tPBTriangle_tick (const tPBTriangle c)
425#endif
426
427{
428
429 uint32_t halfWidth =(c->width >> 1);
430 Lfloat floatWidth = c->width * INV_TWO_TO_32;
431 uint32_t t1 = c->phase + halfWidth;
432
433 uint32_t t2 = c->phase + (4294967296u - halfWidth);
434
435 Lfloat t1F = t1 * INV_TWO_TO_32;
436 Lfloat t2F = t2 * INV_TWO_TO_32;
437 Lfloat t = c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_32;
438 Lfloat incFloat = c->inc * INV_TWO_TO_32;
439
440 float y = t * 2.0f;
441
442 if (y >= 2.0f - floatWidth) {
443 y = (y - 2.0f) / floatWidth;
444 } else if (y >= floatWidth) {
445 y = 1.0f - (y - floatWidth) / (1.0f - floatWidth);
446 } else {
447 y /= floatWidth;
448 }
449 Lfloat blampOne = blamp(t1F, incFloat);
450 Lfloat blampTwo = blamp(t2F, incFloat);
451 Lfloat scaling = incFloat / (floatWidth - floatWidth * floatWidth) ;
452 y += scaling * (blampOne - blampTwo);
453 c->phase += c->inc;
454 return y;
455}

487/* tPBSineTriangle: Anti-aliased Triangle waveform with sine wave, crossfaded between them with shape param. */
488void tPBSineTriangle_init (tPBSineTriangle* const osc, LEAF* const leaf)
489{
490 tPBSineTriangle_initToPool(osc, &leaf->mempool);
491}
492
493void tPBSineTriangle_initToPool (tPBSineTriangle* const osc, tMempool* const mp)
494{
495 _tMempool* m = *mp;
496 _tPBSineTriangle* c = *osc = (_tPBSineTriangle*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tPBSineTriangle), m);
497 c->mempool = m;
498 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
499 tCycle_initToPool(&c->sine, mp);
500 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
501 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = c->invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32;
502 c->inc = 0;
503 c->phase = 0;
504 c->freq = 0.0f;
505 c->shape = 0.0f;
506 c->oneMinusShape = 1.0f;
507}

509void tPBSineTriangle_free (tPBSineTriangle* const cy)

516#ifdef ITCMRAM
517 Lfloat __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tPBSineTriangle_tick (tPBSineTriangle* const osc)
518#else
519Lfloat tPBSineTriangle_tick (tPBSineTriangle const c)
520#endif
521{
522
523 uint32_t t1 = c->phase + TWO_TO_32_ONE_QUARTER;
524
525 uint32_t t2 = c->phase + TWO_TO_32_THREE_QUARTERS;
526
527 Lfloat t1F = t1 * INV_TWO_TO_32;
528 Lfloat t2F = t2 * INV_TWO_TO_32;
529 Lfloat t = c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_32;
530 Lfloat incFloat = c->inc * INV_TWO_TO_32;
531
532 float y = t * 4.0f;
533
534 if (y >= 3.0f) {
535 y -= 4.0f;
536 } else if (y > 1.0f) {
537 y = 2.0f - y;
538 }
539 y += 4.0f * incFloat * (blamp(t1F, incFloat) - blamp(t2F, incFloat));
540 y = y * c->shape; // shape handles the inversion so it's in phase with sine (already * -1.0f)
541
542 y = y + (tCycle_tick(c->sine) * c->oneMinusShape);
543
544 c->phase += c->inc;
545
546 return y;
547}

581void tPBPulse_initToPool (tPBPulse* const osc, tMempool* const mp)
582{

585 c->mempool = m;
586 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
587
588 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
589 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = c->invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32;
590 c->inc = 0;
591 c->phase = 0;
592 c->width = (0.5f * TWO_TO_32);
593 c->oneMinusWidth = c->width;

595}

604#ifdef ITCMRAM
605 Lfloat __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tPBPulse_tick (tPBPulse* const osc)
606#else
607Lfloat tPBPulse_tick (tPBPulse const c)
608#endif
609{
610
611 Lfloat phaseFloat = c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_32;
612 Lfloat incFloat = c->inc * INV_TWO_TO_32;
613 Lfloat backwardsPhaseFloat = (c->phase + c->oneMinusWidth) * INV_TWO_TO_32;
614 Lfloat widthFloat =c->width *INV_TWO_TO_32;
615 Lfloat out = -2.0f * widthFloat;
616 if (phaseFloat < widthFloat) {
617 out += 2.0f;
618 }
619 out += LEAF_poly_blep(phaseFloat,incFloat);
620 out -= LEAF_poly_blep(backwardsPhaseFloat, incFloat);
621 c->phase += c->inc;
622 return out;
623
624}

637void tPBPulse_setWidth (tPBPulse const c, Lfloat width)
638{
639 //clip width to avoid silence from pulse widths of 0 or 1
640 if (width < 0.05f)
641 {
642 width = 0.05f;
643 }
644 if (width > 0.95f)
645 {
646 width = 0.95f;
647 }
648 c->oneMinusWidth = (1.0f - width) * TWO_TO_32;
649 c->width = width * TWO_TO_32;
650}

661/* tSawtooth: Anti-aliased Sawtooth waveform. */
662void tPBSaw_init (tPBSaw* const osc, LEAF* const leaf)
663{
664 tPBSaw_initToPool(osc, &leaf->mempool);
665}
666
667void tPBSaw_initToPool (tPBSaw* const osc, tMempool* const mp)
668{
669 _tMempool* m = *mp;
670 _tPBSaw* c = *osc = (_tPBSaw*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tPBSaw), m);
671 c->mempool = m;
672 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
673
674 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
675 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = c->invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32;
676 c->inc = 0;
677 c->phase = 0;
678 c->freq = 0.0f;
679}
680
681void tPBSaw_free (tPBSaw* const osc)
682{
683 _tPBSaw* c = *osc;
684
685 mpool_free((char*)c, c->mempool);
686}
687
688#ifdef ITCMRAM
689 Lfloat __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tPBSaw_tick (tPBSaw* const osc)
690#else
691Lfloat tPBSaw_tick (tPBSaw const c)
692#endif
693{
694 Lfloat out = (c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_31) - 1.0f;
695
696 Lfloat phaseFloat = c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_32;
697 Lfloat incFloat = c->inc * INV_TWO_TO_32;
698 out -= LEAF_poly_blep(phaseFloat, incFloat);
699 c->phase += c->inc;
700 return (-1.0f * out);
701}
702
703#ifdef ITCMRAM
704 void __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tPBSaw_setFreq (tPBSaw* const osc, Lfloat freq)
705#else
706void tPBSaw_setFreq (tPBSaw const c, Lfloat freq)
707#endif
708{
709 c->freq = freq;
710 c->inc = freq * c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32;
711}
712
713void tPBSaw_setSampleRate (tPBSaw const c, Lfloat sr)
714{
715 c->invSampleRate = 1.0f/sr;
716 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = c->invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32;
717 tPBSaw_setFreq(c, c->freq);
718}

723/* tSawtooth: Anti-aliased Sawtooth waveform. */
724void tPBSawSquare_init (tPBSawSquare* const osc, LEAF* const leaf)
725{

729void tPBSawSquare_initToPool (tPBSawSquare* const osc, tMempool* const mp)
730{
731 _tMempool* m = *mp;
732 _tPBSawSquare* c = *osc = (_tPBSawSquare*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tPBSawSquare), m);
733 c->mempool = m;
734 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
735
736 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
737 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = c->invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32;
738 c->inc = 0;
739 c->phase = 0;
740 c->freq = 0.0f;
741 c->shape = 0.0f;
742 c->oneMinusShape = 1.0f;
743
744}
745
746void tPBSawSquare_free (tPBSawSquare* const osc)
747{
748 _tPBSawSquare* c = *osc;

753
754#ifdef ITCMRAM
755Lfloat __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tPBSawSquare_tick (tPBSawSquare* const osc)
756#else
757Lfloat tPBSawSquare_tick (tPBSawSquare const c)
758#endif
759{
760 //Lfloat squareOut = ((c->phase < 2147483648u) * 2.0f) - 1.0f;
761 Lfloat sawOut = (c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_32 * 2.0f) - 1.0f;
762 Lfloat phaseFloat = c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_32;
763 Lfloat incFloat = c->inc * INV_TWO_TO_32;
764 Lfloat backwardsPhaseFloat = (c->phase + 2147483648u) * INV_TWO_TO_32;
765 Lfloat resetBlep = LEAF_poly_blep(phaseFloat,incFloat);
766 Lfloat midBlep = LEAF_poly_blep(backwardsPhaseFloat, incFloat);
767
768 Lfloat squareOut = -1.0f;
769 if (phaseFloat < 0.5f) {
770 squareOut += 2.0f;
771 }
772 sawOut -= resetBlep;
773
774 squareOut += resetBlep;
775 squareOut -= midBlep;
776
777 c->phase += c->inc;
778
779 return ((-1.0f * sawOut) * c->oneMinusShape) + (squareOut * c->shape);
780}

786#endif
787{
788 c->freq = freq;
789 c->inc = (freq * c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32);
790

810
811/* tSawtooth: Anti-aliased Sawtooth waveform. */
812void tSawOS_init (tSawOS* const osc, uint8_t OS_ratio, uint8_t filterOrder, LEAF* const leaf)
813{
814 tSawOS_initToPool(osc, OS_ratio, filterOrder, &leaf->mempool);
815}
816
817void tSawOS_initToPool (tSawOS* const osc, uint8_t OS_ratio, uint8_t filterOrder, tMempool* const mp)
818{
819 _tMempool* m = *mp;
820 _tSawOS* c = *osc = (_tSawOS*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tSawOS), m);
821 c->mempool = m;
822 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
823 c->OSratio = OS_ratio;
824 c->inc = 0;
825 c->phase = 0;
826 c->invSampleRateOS = 1.0f / (leaf->sampleRate * OS_ratio);
827 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32OS = (c->invSampleRateOS * TWO_TO_32);
828 c->filterOrder = filterOrder;
829 c->aaFilter = (tSVF*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(tSVF) * filterOrder, m);
830
831 for (int i = 0; i < filterOrder; i++)
832 {
833 Lfloat Qval = 0.5f/cosf((1.0f+2.0f*i)*PI/(4*filterOrder));
834
835 tSVF_initToPool(&c->aaFilter[i], SVFTypeLowpass, (19000.0f / OS_ratio), Qval, mp);
836 }
837 tSawOS_setFreq(c, 220.0f);
838}
839
840void tSawOS_free (tSawOS* const osc)
841{
842 _tSawOS* c = *osc;
843 for (int i = 0; i < c->filterOrder; ++i) tSVF_free(&c->aaFilter[i]);
844 mpool_free((char*)c->aaFilter, c->mempool);
845 mpool_free((char*)c, c->mempool);
846}
847
848Lfloat tSawOS_tick (tSawOS const c)
849{
850 Lfloat tempFloat = 0.0f;
851 for (int i = 0; i < c->OSratio; i++)
852 {
853 c->phase = (c->phase + c->inc);
854 tempFloat = (c->phase * INV_TWO_TO_16)- 1.0f; // inv 2 to 32, then multiplied by 2, same as inv 2 to 16
855 for (int k = 0; k < c->filterOrder; k++)
856 {
857 tempFloat = tSVF_tick(c->aaFilter[k], tempFloat);
858 }
859 }
860 return tempFloat;
861}
862
863void tSawOS_setFreq (tSawOS const c, Lfloat freq)
864{
865 c->freq = freq;
866 c->inc = freq * c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32OS;
867}
868
869void tSawOS_setSampleRate (tSawOS const c, Lfloat sr)
870{
871 c->invSampleRateOS = 1.0f/(sr * c->OSratio);
872 tSawOS_setFreq(c, c->freq);
873}

930void tNoise_initToPool (tNoise* const ns, NoiseType type, tMempool* const mp)

937 n->type = type;

947
948Lfloat tNoise_tick(tNoise const n)
949{
950 Lfloat rand = (n->rand() * 2.0f) - 1.0f;
951
952 if (n->type == PinkNoise)
953 {
954 Lfloat tmp;
955 n->pinkb0 = 0.99765f * n->pinkb0 + rand * 0.0990460f;
956 n->pinkb1 = 0.96300f * n->pinkb1 + rand * 0.2965164f;
957 n->pinkb2 = 0.57000f * n->pinkb2 + rand * 1.0526913f;
958 tmp = n->pinkb0 + n->pinkb1 + n->pinkb2 + rand * 0.1848f;
959 return (tmp * 0.05f);
960 }
961 else // WhiteNoise
962 {
963 return rand;
964 }
965}

1018void tNeuron_reset(tNeuron const n)
1019{
1020 tPoleZero_setBlockZero(n->f, 0.99f);
1021
1022 n->timeStep = (44100.0f * n->invSampleRate) / 50.0f;
1023
1024 n->current = 0.0f; // 100.0f for sound
1025 n->voltage = 0.0f;
1026
1027 n->mode = NeuronNormal;
1028
1029 n->P[0] = 0.0f;
1030 n->P[1] = 0.0f;
1031 n->P[2] = 1.0f;
1032
1033 n->V[0] = -12.0f;
1034 n->V[1] = 115.0f;
1035 n->V[2] = 10.613f;
1036
1037 n->gK = 36.0f;
1038 n->gN = 120.0f;
1039 n->gL = 0.3f;
1040 n->C = 1.0f;
1041
1042 n->rate[2] = n->gL/n->C;
1043}
1044
1045void tNeuron_setV1(tNeuron const n, Lfloat V1)
1046{
1047 n->V[0] = V1;
1048}

1051{
1052 n->V[1] = V2;
1053}
1054
1055void tNeuron_setV3(tNeuron const n, Lfloat V3)
1056{
1057 n->V[2] = V3;
1058}
1059
1060void tNeuron_setTimeStep(tNeuron const n, Lfloat timeStep)
1061{
1062 n->timeStep = (44100.0f * n->invSampleRate) * timeStep;
1063}
1064
1065void tNeuron_setK(tNeuron const n, Lfloat K)
1066{
1067 n->gK = K;
1068}
1069
1070void tNeuron_setL(tNeuron const n, Lfloat L)
1071{
1072 n->gL = L;
1073 n->rate[2] = n->gL/n->C;
1074}
1075
1076void tNeuron_setN(tNeuron const n, Lfloat N)
1077{
1078 n->gN = N;
1079}
1080
1081void tNeuron_setC(tNeuron const n, Lfloat C)
1082{
1083 n->C = C;
1084 n->rate[2] = n->gL/n->C;
1085}
1086
1087Lfloat tNeuron_tick(tNeuron const n)
1088{
1089 Lfloat output = 0.0f;
1090 Lfloat voltage = n->voltage;
1091
1092 n->alpha[0] = (0.01f * (10.0f - voltage)) / (expf((10.0f - voltage)/10.0f) - 1.0f);
1093 n->alpha[1] = (0.1f * (25.0f-voltage)) / (expf((25.0f-voltage)/10.0f) - 1.0f);
1094 n->alpha[2] = (0.07f * expf((-1.0f * voltage)/20.0f));
1095
1096 n->beta[0] = (0.125f * expf((-1.0f* voltage)/80.0f));
1097 n->beta[1] = (4.0f * expf((-1.0f * voltage)/18.0f));
1098 n->beta[2] = (1.0f / (expf((30.0f-voltage)/10.0f) + 1.0f));
1099
1100 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
1101 {
1102 n->P[i] = (n->alpha[i] * n->timeStep) + ((1.0f - ((n->alpha[i] + n->beta[i]) * n->timeStep)) * n->P[i]);
1103
1104 if (n->P[i] > 1.0f) n->P[i] = 0.0f;
1105 else if (n->P[i] < -1.0f) n->P[i] = 0.0f;
1106 }
1107 // rate[0]= k ; rate[1] = Na ; rate[2] = l
1108 n->rate[0] = ((n->gK * powf(n->P[0], 4.0f)) / n->C);
1109 n->rate[1] = ((n->gN * powf(n->P[1], 3.0f) * n->P[2]) / n->C);
1110
1111 //calculate the final membrane voltage based on the computed variables
1112 n->voltage = voltage +
1113 (n->timeStep * n->current / n->C) -
1114 (n->timeStep * ( n->rate[0] * (voltage - n->V[0]) + n->rate[1] * (voltage - n->V[1]) + n->rate[2] * (voltage - n->V[2])));
1115
1116 if (n->mode == NeuronTanh)
1117 {
1118 n->voltage = 100.0f * tanhf(0.01f * n->voltage);
1119 }
1120 else if (n->mode == NeuronAaltoShaper)
1121 {
1122 Lfloat shapeVoltage = 0.01f * n->voltage;
1123
1124 Lfloat w, c, xc, xc2, xc4;
1125
1126 Lfloat sqrt8 = 2.82842712475f;
1127
1128 Lfloat wscale = 1.30612244898f;
1129 Lfloat m_drive = 1.0f;
1130
1131 xc = LEAF_clip(-sqrt8, shapeVoltage, sqrt8);
1132
1133 xc2 = xc*xc;
1134
1135 c = 0.5f * shapeVoltage * (3.0f - (xc2));
1136
1137 xc4 = xc2 * xc2;
1138
1139 w = (1.0f - xc2 * 0.25f + xc4 * 0.015625f) * wscale;
1140
1141 shapeVoltage = w * (c + 0.05f * xc2) * (m_drive + 0.75f);
1142
1143 n->voltage = 100.0f * shapeVoltage;
1144 }
1145
1146
1147 if (n->voltage > 100.0f) n->voltage = 100.0f;
1148 else if (n->voltage < -100.) n->voltage = -100.0f;
1149
1150 //(inputCurrent + (voltage - ((voltage * timeStep) / timeConstant)) + P[0] + P[1] + P[2]) => voltage;
1151 // now we should have a result
1152 //set the output voltage to the "step" ugen, which controls the DAC.
1153 output = n->voltage * 0.01f; // volts
1154
1155 output = tPoleZero_tick(n->f, output);
1156
1157 return output;
1158
1159}
1160
1161void tNeuron_setMode (tNeuron const n, NeuronMode mode)
1162{

1172{

1178
1179void tMBPulse_init(tMBPulse* const osc, LEAF* const leaf)
1180{
1181 tMBPulse_initToPool(osc, &leaf->mempool);
1182}
1183
1184void tMBPulse_initToPool(tMBPulse* const osc, tMempool* const pool)
1185{
1186 _tMempool* m = *pool;
1187 _tMBPulse* c = *osc = (_tMBPulse*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tMBPulse), m);
1188 c->mempool = m;
1189 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
1190
1191 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
1192
1193
1194 c->freq = 440.f;
1195 c->lastsyncin = 0.0f;
1196 c->sync = 0.0f;
1197 c->syncdir = 1.0f;
1198 c->softsync = 0;
1199 c->waveform = 0.0f;
1200 c->_z = 0.0f;
1201 c->_j = 0;
1202 c->_p = 0.0f; /* phase [0, 1) */
1203 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate; /* phase increment */
1204 c->_b = 0.5f * (1.0f + c->waveform); /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
1205 c->_x = 0.5f; /* temporary output variable */
1206 c->_k = 0.0f; /* output state, 0 = high (0.5f), 1 = low (-0.5f) */
1207 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
1208 c->numBLEPs = 0;
1209 c->mostRecentBLEP = 0;
1210 c->maxBLEPphase = MINBLEP_PHASES * STEP_DD_PULSE_LENGTH;
1211 memset (c->BLEPindices, 0, 64 * sizeof (uint16_t));
1212 memset (c->_f, 0, 8 * sizeof (Lfloat));
1213}
1214
1215void tMBPulse_free(tMBPulse* const osc)
1216{
1217 _tMBPulse* c = *osc;
1218 mpool_free((char*)c, c->mempool);
1219}
1220
1221//#ifdef ITCMRAM
1222//void __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(tMBPulse* const osc, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale)
1223//#else
1224void tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(tMBPulse const c, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale)
1225//#endif
1226{
1227 Lfloat r;
1228 long i;
1229
1230 r = MINBLEP_PHASES * phase * inv_w;
1231 i = lrintf(r - 0.5f);
1232 r -= (Lfloat)i;
1233 i &= MINBLEP_PHASE_MASK; /* extreme modulation can cause i to be out-of-range */
1234 c->mostRecentBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP + 1) & 63;
1235 c->BLEPindices[c->mostRecentBLEP] = i;
1236 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][0] = r;
1237 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][1] = scale;
1238 c->numBLEPs = (c->numBLEPs + 1) & 63;
1239}
1240
1241
1242Lfloat tMBPulse_tick(tMBPulse const c)
1243{
1244 int j, k;
1245 Lfloat sync;
1246 Lfloat b, p, w, x, z, sw;
1247
1248 sync = c->sync;
1249
1250
1251 p = c->_p; /* phase [0, 1) */
1252 w = c->_w; /* phase increment */
1253 b = c->_b; /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
1254 x = c->_x; /* temporary output variable */
1255 z = c->_z; /* low pass filter state */
1256 j = c->_j; /* index into buffer _f */
1257 k = c->_k; /* output state, 0 = high (0.5f), 1 = low (-0.5f) */
1258
1259
1260 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync > 0) c->syncdir = -c->syncdir;
1261
1262 sw = w * c->syncdir;
1263 Lfloat inv_sw = c->_inv_w * c->syncdir;
1264 p += sw - (int)sw;
1265
1266 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync == 0) { /* sync to master */
1267 Lfloat eof_offset = sync * sw;
1268 Lfloat p_at_reset = p - eof_offset;
1269
1270 if (sw > 0) p = eof_offset;
1271 else if (sw < 0) p = 1.0f - eof_offset;
1272
1273 /* place any DDs that may have occurred in subsample before reset */
1274 if (!k) {
1275 if (sw > 0)
1276 {
1277 if (p_at_reset >= b) {
1278 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -1.0f);
1279 k = 1;
1280 x = -0.5f;
1281 }
1282 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
1283 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
1284 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, 1.0f);
1285 k = 0;
1286 x = 0.5f;
1287 }
1288 }
1289 else if (sw < 0)
1290 {
1291 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
1292 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
1293 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
1294 k = 1;
1295 x = -0.5f;
1296 }
1297 if (k && p_at_reset < b) {
1298 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, 1.0f);
1299 k = 0;
1300 x = 0.5f;
1301 }
1302 }
1303 } else {
1304 if (sw > 0)
1305 {
1306 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
1307 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
1308 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, 1.0f);
1309 k = 0;
1310 x = 0.5f;
1311 }
1312 if (!k && p_at_reset >= b) {
1313 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -1.0f);
1314 k = 1;
1315 x = -0.5f;
1316 }
1317 }
1318 else if (sw < 0)
1319 {
1320 if (p_at_reset < b) {
1321 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, 1.0f);
1322 k = 0;
1323 x = 0.5f;
1324 }
1325 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
1326 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
1327 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
1328 k = 1;
1329 x = -0.5f;
1330 }
1331 }
1332 }
1333
1334 /* now place reset DD */
1335 if (sw > 0)
1336 {
1337 if (k) {
1338 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 1.0f);
1339 k = 0;
1340 x = 0.5f;
1341 }
1342 if (p >= b) {
1343 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -1.0f);
1344 k = 1;
1345 x = -0.5f;
1346 }
1347 }
1348 else if (sw < 0)
1349 {
1350 if (!k) {
1351 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
1352 k = 1;
1353 x = -0.5f;
1354 }
1355 if (p < b) {
1356 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, 1.0f);
1357 k = 0;
1358 x = 0.5f;
1359 }
1360 }
1361 } else if (!k) { /* normal operation, signal currently high */
1362
1363 if (sw > 0)
1364 {
1365 if (p >= b) {
1366 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -1.0f);
1367 k = 1;
1368 x = -0.5f;
1369 }
1370 if (p >= 1.0f) {
1371 p -= 1.0f;
1372 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 1.0f);
1373 k = 0;
1374 x = 0.5f;
1375 }
1376 }
1377 else if (sw < 0)
1378 {
1379 if (p < 0.0f) {
1380 p += 1.0f;
1381 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
1382 k = 1;
1383 x = -0.5f;
1384 }
1385 if (k && p < b) {
1386 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, 1.0f);
1387 k = 0;
1388 x = 0.5f;
1389 }
1390 }
1391
1392 } else { /* normal operation, signal currently low */
1393
1394 if (sw > 0)
1395 {
1396 if (p >= 1.0f) {
1397 p -= 1.0f;
1398 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 1.0f);
1399 k = 0;
1400 x = 0.5f;
1401 }
1402 if (!k && p >= b) {
1403 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -1.0f);
1404 k = 1;
1405 x = -0.5f;
1406 }
1407 }
1408 else if (sw < 0)
1409 {
1410 if (p < b) {
1411 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, 1.0f);
1412 k = 0;
1413 x = 0.5f;
1414 }
1415 if (p < 0.0f) {
1416 p += 1.0f;
1417 tMBPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
1418 k = 1;
1419 x = -0.5f;
1420 }
1421 }
1422 }
1423
1424 int currentSamp = (j + DD_SAMPLE_DELAY) & 7;
1425
1426 c->_f[currentSamp] = x;
1427
1428 volatile uint8_t numBLEPsAtLoopStart = c->numBLEPs;
1429 for (int i = 0; i < numBLEPsAtLoopStart; i++)
1430 {
1431 volatile uint16_t whichBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP - i);
1432 whichBLEP &= 63;
1433
1434 //use the scale and r values from the BLEPproperties array to compute the current state of each active BLEP and add it to the output value
1435 c->_f[j] += c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][1] * (step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].value + c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][0] * step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].delta);
1436
1437 //increment the position in the BLEP table
1438 c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] += MINBLEP_PHASES;
1439 //check if this BLEP is finished and if so mark it as inactive so it isn't computed anymore.
1440 if (c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] >= c->maxBLEPphase)
1441 {
1442 c->numBLEPs--;
1443 }
1444
1445 }
1446
1447 z += 0.5f * (c->_f[j] - z);
1448 c->out = z;
1449
1450 j = (j+1) & 7;
1451
1452 c->_p = p;
1453 c->_w = w;
1454 c->_b = b;
1455 c->_x = x;
1456 c->_z = z;
1457 c->_j = j;
1458 c->_k = k;
1459
1460 return -c->out;
1461}

1463void tMBPulse_setFreq(tMBPulse const c, Lfloat f)
1464{
1465 c->freq = f;
1466 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate; /* phase increment */
1467 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
1468}

1470void tMBPulse_setWidth(tMBPulse const c, Lfloat w)
1471{
1472 c->waveform = w;
1473 c->_b = 0.5f * (1.0f + c->waveform);
1474}
1475
1476Lfloat tMBPulse_sync(tMBPulse const c, Lfloat value)
1477{
1478 //based on https://github.com/VCVRack/Fundamental/blob/5799ee2a9b21492b42ebcb9b65d5395ef5c1cbe2/src/VCO.cpp#L123
1479 Lfloat last = c->lastsyncin;
1480 Lfloat delta = value - last;
1481 Lfloat crossing = -last / delta;
1482 c->lastsyncin = value;
1483 if ((0.f < crossing) && (crossing <= 1.f) && (value >= 0.f))
1484 c->sync = (1.f - crossing) * delta;
1485 else c->sync = 0.f;
1486
1487 return value;
1488}

1490void tMBPulse_setPhase(tMBPulse const c, Lfloat phase)

1513//==========================================================================================================
1514
1515void tMBTriangle_init(tMBTriangle* const osc, LEAF* const leaf)
1516{
1517 tMBTriangle_initToPool(osc, &leaf->mempool);
1518}
1519
1520void tMBTriangle_initToPool(tMBTriangle* const osc, tMempool* const pool)
1521{
1522 _tMempool* m = *pool;
1523 _tMBTriangle* c = *osc = (_tMBTriangle*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tMBTriangle), m);
1524 c->mempool = m;
1525 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
1526
1527 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
1528 c->freq = 440.f;
1529 c->lastsyncin = 0.0f;
1530 c->sync = 0.0f;
1531 c->syncdir = 1.0f;
1532 c->softsync = 0;
1533 c->waveform = 0.0f;
1534 c->_z = 0.0f;
1535 c->_j = 0;
1536 c->_p = 0.25f; /* phase [0, 1) */
1537 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate; /* phase increment */
1538 c->_b = 0.5f * (1.0f + c->waveform); /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
1539 c->_k = 0.0f; /* output state, 0 = high (0.5f), 1 = low (-0.5f) */
1540 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
1541 c->numBLEPs = 0;
1542 c->mostRecentBLEP = 0;
1543 c->maxBLEPphase = MINBLEP_PHASES * STEP_DD_PULSE_LENGTH;
1544 c->maxBLEPphaseSlope = MINBLEP_PHASES * SLOPE_DD_PULSE_LENGTH;
1545 memset (c->BLEPindices, 0, 64 * sizeof (uint16_t));
1546 memset (c->_f, 0, 8 * sizeof (Lfloat));
1547}
1548
1549void tMBTriangle_free(tMBTriangle* const osc)
1550{
1551 _tMBTriangle* c = *osc;
1552 mpool_free((char*)c, c->mempool);
1553}
1554
1555//#ifdef ITCMRAM
1556//void __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(tMBTriangle* const osc, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale, Lfloat stepOrSlope, Lfloat w)
1557//#else
1558void tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(tMBTriangle const c, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale, Lfloat stepOrSlope, Lfloat w)
1559//#endif
1560{
1561 Lfloat r;
1562 long i;
1563
1564 r = MINBLEP_PHASES * phase * inv_w;
1565 i = lrintf(r - 0.5f);
1566 r -= (Lfloat)i;
1567 i &= MINBLEP_PHASE_MASK; /* extreme modulation can cause i to be out-of-range */
1568 scale *= w;
1569 c->mostRecentBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP + 1) & 63;
1570 c->BLEPindices[c->mostRecentBLEP] = i;
1571 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][0] = r;
1572 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][1] = scale;
1573 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][2] = stepOrSlope;
1574 c->numBLEPs = (c->numBLEPs + 1) & 63;
1575}
1576
1577Lfloat tMBTriangle_tick(tMBTriangle const c)
1578{
1579 int j, k;
1580 Lfloat sync;
1581 Lfloat b, b1, invB, invB1, p, w, sw, z;
1582 Lfloat x = 0.5f;
1583
1584 sync = c->sync;
1585
1586 p = c->_p; /* phase [0, 1) */
1587 w = c->_w; /* phase increment */
1588 b = c->_b; /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
1589 invB = 1.0f / b;
1590 z = c->_z; /* low pass filter state */
1591 j = c->_j; /* index into buffer _f */
1592 k = c->_k; /* output state, 0 = positive slope, 1 = negative slope */
1593
1594
1595
1596 b = 0.5f * (1.0f + c->waveform);
1597 b1 = 1.0f - b;
1598 invB1 = 1.0f / b1;
1599 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync > 0) c->syncdir = -c->syncdir;
1600
1601 sw = w * c->syncdir;
1602 Lfloat inv_sw = c->_inv_w * c->syncdir;
1603 p += sw - (int)sw;
1604
1605 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync == 0) { /* sync to master */
1606 Lfloat eof_offset = sync * sw;
1607 Lfloat p_at_reset = p - eof_offset;
1608
1609 if (sw > 0) p = eof_offset;
1610 else if (sw < 0) p = 1.0f - eof_offset;
1611 //
1612 /* place any DDs that may have occurred in subsample before reset */
1613
1614 if (!k) {
1615 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
1616 if (sw > 0)
1617 {
1618 if (p_at_reset >= b) {
1619 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
1620 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
1621 k = 1;
1622 }
1623 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
1624 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
1625 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
1626 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
1627 k = 0;
1628 }
1629 }
1630 else if (sw < 0)
1631 {
1632 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
1633 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
1634 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
1635 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
1636 k = 1;
1637 }
1638 if (k && p_at_reset < b) {
1639 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
1640 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
1641 k = 0;
1642 }
1643 }
1644 } else {
1645 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
1646 if (sw > 0)
1647 {
1648 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
1649 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
1650 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
1651 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
1652 k = 0;
1653 }
1654 if (!k && p_at_reset >= b) {
1655 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
1656 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
1657 k = 1;
1658 }
1659 }
1660 else if (sw < 0)
1661 {
1662 if (p_at_reset < b) {
1663 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
1664 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
1665 k = 0;
1666 }
1667 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
1668 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
1669 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
1670 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
1671 k = 1;
1672 }
1673 }
1674 }
1675
1676 /* now place reset DDs */
1677 if (sw > 0)
1678 {
1679 if (k)
1680 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
1681 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, -0.5f - x, 0.0f, sw);
1682 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
1683 k = 0;
1684 if (p >= b) {
1685 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
1686 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
1687 k = 1;
1688 }
1689 }
1690 else if (sw < 0)
1691 {
1692 if (!k)
1693 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
1694 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -0.5f - x, 0.0f, -sw);
1695 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
1696 k = 1;
1697 if (p < b) {
1698 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
1699 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
1700 k = 0;
1701 }
1702 }
1703 } else if (!k) { /* normal operation, slope currently up */
1704
1705 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
1706 if (sw > 0)
1707 {
1708 if (p >= b) {
1709 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;;
1710 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
1711 k = 1;
1712 }
1713 if (p >= 1.0f) {
1714 p -= 1.0f;
1715 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
1716 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
1717 k = 0;
1718 }
1719 }
1720 else if (sw < 0)
1721 {
1722 if (p < 0.0f) {
1723 p += 1.0f;
1724 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
1725 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
1726 k = 1;
1727 }
1728 if (k && p < b) {
1729 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
1730 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
1731 k = 0;
1732 }
1733 }
1734
1735 } else { /* normal operation, slope currently down */
1736
1737 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
1738 if (sw > 0)
1739 {
1740 if (p >= 1.0f) {
1741 p -= 1.0f;
1742 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
1743 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
1744 k = 0;
1745 }
1746 if (!k && p >= b) {
1747 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
1748 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
1749 k = 1;
1750 }
1751 }
1752 else if (sw < 0)
1753 {
1754 if (p < b) {
1755 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
1756 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
1757 k = 0;
1758 }
1759 if (p < 0.0f) {
1760 p += 1.0f;
1761 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
1762 tMBTriangle_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
1763 k = 1;
1764 }
1765 }
1766 }
1767 int currentSamp = (j + DD_SAMPLE_DELAY) & 7;
1768
1769 c->_f[currentSamp] = x;
1770
1771 volatile uint8_t numBLEPsAtLoopStart = c->numBLEPs;
1772 for (int i = 0; i < numBLEPsAtLoopStart; i++)
1773 {
1774 volatile uint16_t whichBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP - i);
1775 whichBLEP &= 63;
1776
1777 //use the scale and r values from the BLEPproperties array to compute the current state of each active BLEP and add it to the output value
1778
1779 if (c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][2] < 0.5f) //step blep
1780 {
1781 c->_f[j] += c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][1] * (step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].value + c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][0] * step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].delta);
1782 //increment the position in the BLEP table
1783 c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] += MINBLEP_PHASES;
1784 //check if this BLEP is finished and if so mark it as inactive so it isn't computed anymore.
1785 if (c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] >= c->maxBLEPphase)
1786 {
1787 c->numBLEPs--;
1788 }
1789 }
1790 else // slope blep
1791 {
1792 c->_f[j] += c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][1] * (slope_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]] + c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][0] * (slope_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]+1] - slope_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]]));
1793 //increment the position in the BLEP table
1794 c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] += MINBLEP_PHASES;
1795 //check if this BLEP is finished and if so mark it as inactive so it isn't computed anymore.
1796 if (c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] >= (c->maxBLEPphaseSlope)) //slope bleps are 71 length instead of 72 length so subtract 1
1797 {
1798 c->numBLEPs--;
1799 }
1800 }
1801 }
1802
1803 z += 0.5f * (c->_f[j] - z);
1804 c->out = z;
1805 j = (j+1) & 7;
1806 c->_p = p;
1807 c->_w = w;
1808 c->_b = b;
1809 c->_z = z;
1810 c->_j = j;
1811 c->_k = k;
1812
1813 return -c->out;
1814}
1815
1816void tMBTriangle_setFreq(tMBTriangle const c, Lfloat f)
1817{
1818 c->freq = f;
1819 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate; /* phase increment */
1820 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
1821 //c->quarterwaveoffset = c->_w * 0.25f;
1822}
1823
1824void tMBTriangle_setWidth(tMBTriangle const c, Lfloat w)
1825{
1826 w = LEAF_clip(0.0f, w, 0.99f);
1827 c->waveform = w;
1828}
1829
1830Lfloat tMBTriangle_sync(tMBTriangle const c, Lfloat value)
1831{
1832 //based on https://github.com/VCVRack/Fundamental/blob/5799ee2a9b21492b42ebcb9b65d5395ef5c1cbe2/src/VCO.cpp#L123
1833 Lfloat last = c->lastsyncin;
1834 Lfloat delta = value - last;
1835 Lfloat crossing = -last / delta;
1836 c->lastsyncin = value;
1837 if ((0.f < crossing) && (crossing <= 1.f) && (value >= 0.f))
1838 c->sync = (1.f - crossing) * delta;
1839 else c->sync = 0.f;
1840
1841 return value;
1842}

1875void tMBSineTri_initToPool(tMBSineTri* const osc, tMempool* const pool)
1876{
1877 _tMempool* m = *pool;
1878 _tMBSineTri* c = *osc = (_tMBSineTri*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tMBSineTri), m);
1879 c->mempool = m;
1880 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
1881
1882 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
1883 c->freq = 440.f;
1884 c->lastsyncin = 0.0f;
1885 c->sync = 0.0f;
1886 c->syncdir = 1.0f;
1887 c->softsync = 0;
1888 c->waveform = 0.0f;
1889 c->shape = 0.0f;
1890 c->_z = 0.0f;
1891 c->_j = 0;
1892 c->_sinPhase = 0.0f;
1893 c->_p = 0.25f; /* phase [0, 1) */
1894 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate; /* phase increment */
1895 c->_b = 0.5f * (1.0f + c->waveform); /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
1896 c->_k = 0.0f; /* output state, 0 = high (0.5f), 1 = low (-0.5f) */
1897 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
1898 c->numBLEPs = 0;
1899 c->mostRecentBLEP = 0;
1900 c->maxBLEPphase = MINBLEP_PHASES * STEP_DD_PULSE_LENGTH;
1901 c->maxBLEPphaseSlope = MINBLEP_PHASES * SLOPE_DD_PULSE_LENGTH;
1902 c->sineMask = 2047;
1903 memset (c->BLEPindices, 0, 64 * sizeof (uint16_t));
1904 memset (c->_f, 0, 8 * sizeof (Lfloat));
1905}

1913//#ifdef ITCMRAM
1914//void __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(tMBSineTri* const osc, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale, Lfloat stepOrSlope, Lfloat w)
1915//#else
1916void tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(tMBSineTri c, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale, Lfloat stepOrSlope, Lfloat w)
1917//#endif
1918{
1919 Lfloat r;
1920 long i;
1921
1922 r = MINBLEP_PHASES * phase * inv_w;
1923 i = lrintf(r - 0.5f);
1924 r -= (Lfloat)i;
1925 i &= MINBLEP_PHASE_MASK; /* extreme modulation can cause i to be out-of-range */
1926 scale *= w;
1927 c->mostRecentBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP + 1) & 63;
1928 c->BLEPindices[c->mostRecentBLEP] = i;
1929 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][0] = r;
1930 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][1] = scale;
1931 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][2] = stepOrSlope;
1932 c->numBLEPs = (c->numBLEPs + 1) & 63;
1933}

1935Lfloat tMBSineTri_tick(tMBSineTri const c)
1936{
1937 int j, k;
1938 Lfloat sync;
1939 Lfloat b, b1, invB, invB1, p, sinPhase, w, sw, z;
1940 Lfloat x = 0.5f;
1941
1942 sync = c->sync;
1943
1944 p = c->_p; /* phase [0, 1) */
1945 sinPhase = c->_sinPhase;
1946 w = c->_w; /* phase increment */
1947 b = c->_b; /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
1948 invB = 1.0f / b;
1949 z = c->_z; /* low pass filter state */
1950 j = c->_j; /* index into buffer _f */
1951 k = c->_k; /* output state, 0 = positive slope, 1 = negative slope */
1952
1953
1954
1955 b = 0.5f * (1.0f + c->waveform);
1956 b1 = 1.0f - b;
1957 invB1 = 1.0f / b1;
1958 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync > 0) c->syncdir = -c->syncdir;
1959
1960 sw = w * c->syncdir;
1961 Lfloat inv_sw = c->_inv_w * c->syncdir;
1962 Lfloat inc_amount = sw - (int)sw;
1963 p += inc_amount;
1964 sinPhase += inc_amount;
1965
1966 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync == 0) { /* sync to master */
1967 Lfloat eof_offset = sync * sw;
1968 Lfloat p_at_reset = p - eof_offset;
1969 if (sw > 0)
1970 {
1971 p = eof_offset + 0.25f;
1972 sinPhase = eof_offset;
1973 }
1974 else if (sw < 0)
1975 {
1976 p = (1.0f - eof_offset) + 0.25f;
1977 sinPhase = (1.0f - eof_offset);
1978 }
1979 //
1980 /* place any DDs that may have occurred in subsample before reset */
1981
1982 if (!k) {
1983 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
1984 if (sw > 0)
1985 {
1986 if (p_at_reset >= b) {
1987 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
1988 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
1989 k = 1;
1990 }
1991 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
1992 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
1993 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
1994 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
1995 k = 0;
1996 }
1997 }
1998 else if (sw < 0)
1999 {
2000 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
2001 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
2002 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
2003 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
2004 k = 1;
2005 }
2006 if (k && p_at_reset < b) {
2007 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
2008 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
2009 k = 0;
2010 }
2011 }
2012 } else {
2013 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
2014 if (sw > 0)
2015 {
2016 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
2017 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
2018 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
2019 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
2020 k = 0;
2021 }
2022 if (!k && p_at_reset >= b) {
2023 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
2024 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
2025 k = 1;
2026 }
2027 }
2028 else if (sw < 0)
2029 {
2030 if (p_at_reset < b) {
2031 x = -0.5f + p_at_reset * invB;
2032 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
2033 k = 0;
2034 }
2035 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
2036 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
2037 x = 0.5f - (p_at_reset - b) * invB1;
2038 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
2039 k = 1;
2040 }
2041 }
2042 }
2043
2044 /* now place reset DDs */
2045 if (sw > 0)
2046 {
2047 if (k)
2048 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
2049 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 0.0f - x, 0.0f, sw);
2050 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
2051 k = 0;
2052 if (p >= b) {
2053 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
2054 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
2055 k = 1;
2056 }
2057 }
2058 else if (sw < 0)
2059 {
2060 if (!k)
2061 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
2062 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, 0.0f - x, 0.0f, -sw);
2063 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
2064 k = 1;
2065 if (p < b) {
2066 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
2067 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
2068 k = 0;
2069 }
2070 }
2071 } else if (!k) { /* normal operation, slope currently up */
2072
2073 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
2074 if (sw > 0)
2075 {
2076 if (p >= b) {
2077 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;;
2078 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
2079 k = 1;
2080 }
2081 if (p >= 1.0f) {
2082 p -= 1.0f;
2083 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
2084 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
2085 k = 0;
2086 }
2087 }
2088 else if (sw < 0)
2089 {
2090 if (p < 0.0f) {
2091 p += 1.0f;
2092 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
2093 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
2094 k = 1;
2095 }
2096 if (k && p < b) {
2097 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
2098 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
2099 k = 0;
2100 }
2101 }
2102
2103 } else { /* normal operation, slope currently down */
2104
2105 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
2106 if (sw > 0)
2107 {
2108 if (p >= 1.0f) {
2109 p -= 1.0f;
2110 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
2111 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, sw);
2112 k = 0;
2113 }
2114 if (!k && p >= b) {
2115 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
2116 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, sw);
2117 k = 1;
2118 }
2119 }
2120 else if (sw < 0)
2121 {
2122 if (p < b) {
2123 x = -0.5f + p * invB;
2124 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, -invB1 - invB, 1.0f, -sw);
2125 k = 0;
2126 }
2127 if (p < 0.0f) {
2128 p += 1.0f;
2129 x = 0.5f - (p - b) * invB1;
2130 tMBSineTri_place_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, invB + invB1, 1.0f, -sw);
2131 k = 1;
2132 }
2133 }
2134 }
2135 int currentSamp = (j + DD_SAMPLE_DELAY) & 7;
2136
2137 c->_f[currentSamp] = x * c->shape; //add the triangle
2138
2139
2140 Lfloat tempFrac;
2141 uint32_t idx;
2142 Lfloat samp0;
2143 Lfloat samp1;
2144
2145 // Wavetable synthesis
2146 while (sinPhase >= 1.0f)
2147 {
2148 sinPhase -= 1.0f;
2149 }
2150
2151 while (sinPhase < 0.0f)
2152 {
2153 sinPhase += 1.0f;
2154 }
2155 Lfloat tempPhase = (sinPhase * 2048.0f);
2156 idx = (uint32_t)tempPhase; //11 bit table
2157 tempFrac = tempPhase - idx;
2158 samp0 = __leaf_table_sinewave[idx];
2159 idx = (idx + 1) & c->sineMask;
2160 samp1 = __leaf_table_sinewave[idx];
2161
2162 Lfloat sinOut = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * tempFrac) * 0.5f; // 1/2097151
2163
2164 c->_f[currentSamp] += sinOut * (1.0f - c->shape); //add the sine
2165
2166
2167 volatile uint8_t numBLEPsAtLoopStart = c->numBLEPs;
2168 for (int i = 0; i < numBLEPsAtLoopStart; i++)
2169 {
2170 volatile uint16_t whichBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP - i);
2171 whichBLEP &= 63;
2172
2173 //use the scale and r values from the BLEPproperties array to compute the current state of each active BLEP and add it to the output value
2174
2175 if (c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][2] < 0.5f) //step blep
2176 {
2177 c->_f[j] += c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][1] * (step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].value + c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][0] * step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].delta);
2178 //increment the position in the BLEP table
2179 c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] += MINBLEP_PHASES;
2180 //check if this BLEP is finished and if so mark it as inactive so it isn't computed anymore.
2181 if (c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] >= c->maxBLEPphase)
2182 {
2183 c->numBLEPs--;
2184 }
2185 }
2186 else // slope blep
2187 {
2188 c->_f[j] += (c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][1] * (slope_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]] + c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][0] * (slope_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]+1] - slope_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]]))) * c->shape;
2189 //increment the position in the BLEP table
2190 c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] += MINBLEP_PHASES;
2191 //check if this BLEP is finished and if so mark it as inactive so it isn't computed anymore.
2192 if (c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] >= (c->maxBLEPphaseSlope)) //slope bleps are 71 length instead of 72 length so subtract 1
2193 {
2194 c->numBLEPs--;
2195 }
2196 }
2197 }
2198
2199 z += 0.5f * (c->_f[j] - z);
2200 j = (j+1) & 7;
2201 c->out = z;
2202 c->_p = p;
2203 c->_w = w;
2204 c->_b = b;
2205 c->_z = z;
2206 c->_j = j;
2207 c->_k = k;
2208 c->_sinPhase = sinPhase;
2209
2210 return -c->out;
2211}

2227Lfloat tMBSineTri_sync(tMBSineTri const c, Lfloat value)
2228{
2229 //based on https://github.com/VCVRack/Fundamental/blob/5799ee2a9b21492b42ebcb9b65d5395ef5c1cbe2/src/VCO.cpp#L123
2230 Lfloat last = c->lastsyncin;
2231 Lfloat delta = value - last;
2232 Lfloat crossing = -last / delta;
2233 c->lastsyncin = value;
2234 if ((0.f < crossing) && (crossing <= 1.f) && (value >= 0.f))
2235 c->sync = (1.f - crossing) * delta;
2236 else c->sync = 0.f;
2237
2238 return value;
2239}

2330Lfloat tMBSaw_tick(tMBSaw const c)
2331{
2332 int j;
2333 Lfloat sync;
2334 Lfloat p, sw, z;
2335
2336 sync = c->sync;
2337
2338
2339 p = c->_p; /* phase [0, 1) */
2340 z = c->_z; /* low pass filter state */
2341 j = c->_j; /* index into buffer _f */
2342
2343
2344 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync > 0) c->syncdir = -c->syncdir;
2345 sw = c->_w * c->syncdir;
2346 Lfloat inv_sw = c->_inv_w * c->syncdir;
2347 p += sw - (int)sw;
2348
2349 //if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync > 0) {
2350 // Should insert minblep for softsync?
2351 // if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
2352 // p_at_reset -= (int)p_at_reset;
2353 // place_slope_dd(osc, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, 2.0f);
2354 // }
2355 // if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
2356 // p_at_reset += 1.0f - (int)p_at_reset;
2357 // place_slope_dd(osc, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -2.0f);
2358 // }
2359 // if (sw > 0) place_slope_dd(osc, j, p, inv_sw, 2.0f);
2360 // else if (sw < 0) place_slope_dd(osc, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -2.0f);
2361 //}
2362
2363 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync == 0) { /* sync to master */
2364 Lfloat eof_offset = sync * sw;
2365 Lfloat p_at_reset = p - eof_offset;
2366
2367 if (sw > 0) p = eof_offset;
2368 else if (sw < 0) p = 1.0f - eof_offset;
2369
2370 /* place any DD that may have occurred in subsample before reset */
2371 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f) {
2372 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
2373 tMBSaw_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, 1.0f);
2374 }
2375 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f) {
2376 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
2377 tMBSaw_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
2378 }
2379
2380 /* now place reset DD */
2381 if (sw > 0)
2382 tMBSaw_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, p_at_reset);
2383 else if (sw < 0)
2384 tMBSaw_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -p_at_reset);
2385
2386 } else if (p >= 1.0f) { /* normal phase reset */
2387 p -= 1.0f;
2388 tMBSaw_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 1.0f);
2389
2390 } else if (p < 0.0f) {
2391 p += 1.0f;
2392 tMBSaw_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
2393 }
2394
2395 //construct the current output sample based on the state of the active BLEPs
2396
2397 int currentSamp = (j + DD_SAMPLE_DELAY) & 7;
2398
2399 c->_f[currentSamp] = 0.5f - p;
2400
2401 volatile uint8_t numBLEPsAtLoopStart = c->numBLEPs;
2402 for (int i = 0; i < numBLEPsAtLoopStart; i++)
2403 {
2404 volatile uint16_t whichBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP - i);
2405 whichBLEP &= 63;
2406
2407 //use the scale and r values from the BLEPproperties array to compute the current state of each active BLEP and add it to the output value
2408 c->_f[j] += c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][1] * (step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].value + c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][0] * step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].delta);
2409
2410 //increment the position in the BLEP table
2411 c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] += MINBLEP_PHASES;
2412 //check if this BLEP is finished and if so mark it as inactive so it isn't computed anymore.
2413 if (c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] >= c->maxBLEPphase)
2414 {
2415 c->numBLEPs--;
2416 }
2417
2418 }
2419
2420 z += 0.5f * (c->_f[j] - z); // LP filtering
2421 c->out = z;
2422 j = (j+1) & 7; //don't need 128 sample buffer just for lowpass, so only using the first 16 values before wrapping around (probably only need 4 or 8)
2423
2424 c->_p = p;
2425 c->_z = z;
2426 c->_j = j;
2427
2428
2429 return -c->out;
2430}
2431
2432void tMBSaw_setFreq(tMBSaw const c, Lfloat f)
2433{
2434 c->freq = f;
2435
2436 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate;
2437 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
2438}

2440Lfloat tMBSaw_sync(tMBSaw const c, Lfloat value)
2441{
2442 //based on https://github.com/VCVRack/Fundamental/blob/5799ee2a9b21492b42ebcb9b65d5395ef5c1cbe2/src/VCO.cpp#L123
2443 Lfloat last = c->lastsyncin;
2444 Lfloat delta = value - last;
2445 Lfloat crossing = -last / delta;
2446 c->lastsyncin = value;
2447 if ((0.f < crossing) && (crossing <= 1.f) && (value >= 0.f))
2448 c->sync = (1.f - crossing) * delta;
2449 else c->sync = 0.f;
2450
2451 return value;
2452}

2483
2484void tMBSawPulse_initToPool(tMBSawPulse* const osc, tMempool* const pool)
2485{
2486 _tMempool* m = *pool;
2487 _tMBSawPulse* c = *osc = (_tMBSawPulse*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tMBSawPulse), m);
2488 c->mempool = m;
2489 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
2490 c->gain = 1.0f;
2491 c->active = 1;
2492 c->invSampleRate = leaf->invSampleRate;
2493 c->freq = 440.f;
2494 c->lastsyncin = 0.0f;
2495 c->sync = 0.0f;
2496 c->syncdir = 1.0f;
2497 c->softsync = 0;
2498 c->waveform = 0.0f;
2499 c->_z = 0.0f;
2500 c->_j = 0;
2501 c->_p = 0.0f; /* phase [0, 1) */
2502 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate; /* phase increment */
2503 c->_b = 0.5f * (1.0f + c->waveform); /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
2504 c->_x = 0.5f; /* temporary output variable */
2505 c->_k = 0.0f; /* output state, 0 = high (0.5f), 1 = low (-0.5f) */
2506 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
2507 c->numBLEPs = 0;
2508 c->mostRecentBLEP = 0;
2509 c->maxBLEPphase = MINBLEP_PHASES * STEP_DD_PULSE_LENGTH;
2510 memset (c->BLEPindices, 0, 64 * sizeof (uint16_t));
2511 memset (c->_f, 0, 8 * sizeof (Lfloat));
2512
2513}

2516{

2519}

2521
2522#ifdef ITCMRAM
2523void __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(tMBSawPulse* const osc, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale)
2524#else
2525void tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(tMBSawPulse const c, int index, Lfloat phase, Lfloat inv_w, Lfloat scale)
2526#endif
2527{
2528 if (c->active)
2529 {
2530 Lfloat r;
2531 long i;
2532
2533 r = MINBLEP_PHASES * phase * inv_w;
2534 i = lrintf(r - 0.5f);
2535 r -= (Lfloat)i;
2536 i &= MINBLEP_PHASE_MASK; /* extreme modulation can cause i to be out-of-range */
2537 c->mostRecentBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP + 1) & 63;
2538 c->BLEPindices[c->mostRecentBLEP] = i;
2539 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][0] = r;
2540 c->BLEPproperties[c->mostRecentBLEP][1] = scale;
2541
2542 c->numBLEPs = (c->numBLEPs + 1) & 63;
2543 }
2544}
2545
2546
2547
2548#ifdef ITCMRAM
2549Lfloat __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tMBSawPulse_tick(tMBSawPulse* const osc)
2550#else
2551Lfloat tMBSawPulse_tick(tMBSawPulse const c)
2552#endif
2553{
2554 int j, k;
2555 Lfloat sync;
2556 Lfloat b, p, w, x, z, sw;
2557 Lfloat shape = c->shape;
2558 Lfloat sawShape = 1.0f - c->shape;
2559 sync = c->sync;
2560 p = c->_p; /* phase [0, 1) */
2561 w = c->_w; /* phase increment */
2562 b = c->_b; /* duty cycle (0, 1) */
2563 x = c->_x; /* temporary output variable */
2564 z = c->_z; /* low pass filter state */
2565 j = c->_j; /* index into buffer _f */
2566 k = c->_k; /* output state, 0 = high (0.5f), 1 = low (-0.5f) */
2567
2568 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync > 0) c->syncdir = -c->syncdir;
2569
2570 sw = w * c->syncdir;
2571 Lfloat inv_sw = c->_inv_w * c->syncdir;
2572 p += sw - (int)sw;
2573 if (sync > 0.0f && c->softsync == 0)
2574 { /* sync to master */
2575 Lfloat eof_offset = sync * sw;
2576 Lfloat p_at_reset = p - eof_offset;
2577
2578 if (sw > 0) p = eof_offset;
2579 else if (sw < 0) p = 1.0f - eof_offset;
2580
2581 //pulse stuff
2582 /* place any DDs that may have occurred in subsample before reset */
2583 if (!k)
2584 {
2585 if (sw > 0)
2586 {
2587 if (p_at_reset >= b)
2588 {
2589 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -1.0f * shape);
2590 k = 1;
2591 x = -0.5f;
2592 }
2593 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f)
2594 {
2595 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
2596 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, 1.0f);
2597 k = 0;
2598 x = 0.5f;
2599 }
2600 }
2601 else if (sw < 0)
2602 {
2603 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f)
2604 {
2605 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
2606 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
2607 k = 1;
2608 x = -0.5f;
2609 }
2610 if (k && p_at_reset < b)
2611 {
2612 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, 1.0f * shape);
2613 k = 0;
2614 x = 0.5f;
2615 }
2616 }
2617 }
2618 else
2619 {
2620 if (sw > 0)
2621 {
2622 if (p_at_reset >= 1.0f)
2623 {
2624 p_at_reset -= 1.0f;
2625 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset + eof_offset, inv_sw, 1.0f);
2626 k = 0;
2627 x = 0.5f;
2628 }
2629 if (!k && p_at_reset >= b)
2630 {
2631 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p_at_reset - b + eof_offset, inv_sw, -1.0f * shape);
2632 k = 1;
2633 x = -0.5f;
2634 }
2635 }
2636 else if (sw < 0)
2637 {
2638 if (p_at_reset < b)
2639 {
2640 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, 1.0f * shape);
2641 k = 0;
2642 x = 0.5f;
2643 }
2644 if (p_at_reset < 0.0f)
2645 {
2646 p_at_reset += 1.0f;
2647 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p_at_reset - eof_offset, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
2648 k = 1;
2649 x = -0.5f;
2650 }
2651 }
2652 }
2653
2654
2655
2656 if (sw > 0)
2657 {
2658 /* now place reset DD for saw*/
2659 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, p_at_reset * sawShape);
2660 /* now place reset DD for pulse */
2661 if (k) {
2662 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 1.0f * shape);
2663 k = 0;
2664 x = 0.5f;
2665 }
2666 if (p >= b) {
2667 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -1.0f * shape);
2668 k = 1;
2669 x = -0.5f;
2670 }
2671 }
2672 else if (sw < 0)
2673 {
2674 /* now place reset DD for saw*/
2675 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -p_at_reset * sawShape);
2676 /* now place reset DD for pulse */
2677 if (!k) {
2678 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -1.0f * shape);
2679 k = 1;
2680 x = -0.5f;
2681 }
2682 if (p < b) {
2683 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, 1.0f * shape);
2684 k = 0;
2685 x = 0.5f;
2686 }
2687 }
2688
2689
2690 }
2691
2692
2693 else if (!k)
2694 { /* normal operation for pulse, signal currently high */
2695
2696 if (sw > 0)
2697 {
2698 if (p >= b) {
2699 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -1.0f * shape);
2700 k = 1;
2701 x = -0.5f;
2702 }
2703 if (p >= 1.0f) {
2704 p -= 1.0f;
2705 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 1.0f);
2706 k = 0;
2707 x = 0.5f;
2708 }
2709 }
2710 else if (sw < 0)
2711 {
2712 if (p < 0.0f) {
2713 p += 1.0f;
2714 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
2715 k = 1;
2716 x = -0.5f;
2717 }
2718 if (k && p < b) {
2719 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, 1.0f * shape);
2720 k = 0;
2721 x = 0.5f;
2722 }
2723 }
2724
2725 } else { /* normal operation, signal currently low */
2726
2727 if (sw > 0)
2728 {
2729 if (p >= 1.0f) {
2730 p -= 1.0f;
2731 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p, inv_sw, 1.0f);
2732 k = 0;
2733 x = 0.5f;
2734 }
2735 if (!k && p >= b) {
2736 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, p - b, inv_sw, -1.0f * shape);
2737 k = 1;
2738 x = -0.5f;
2739 }
2740 }
2741 else if (sw < 0)
2742 {
2743 if (p < b) {
2744 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, b - p, -inv_sw, 1.0f * shape);
2745 k = 0;
2746 x = 0.5f;
2747 }
2748 if (p < 0.0f) {
2749 p += 1.0f;
2750 tMBSawPulse_place_step_dd_noBuffer(c, j, 1.0f - p, -inv_sw, -1.0f);
2751 k = 1;
2752 x = -0.5f;
2753 }
2754 }
2755 }
2756 int currentSamp = (j + DD_SAMPLE_DELAY) & 7;
2757 c->_f[currentSamp] = ((0.5f - p) * sawShape); //saw
2758
2759 c->_f[currentSamp] += (x * shape);//pulse
2760
2761 volatile uint8_t numBLEPsAtLoopStart = c->numBLEPs;
2762 for (int i = 0; i < numBLEPsAtLoopStart; i++)
2763 {
2764 volatile uint16_t whichBLEP = (c->mostRecentBLEP - i);
2765 whichBLEP &= 63;
2766
2767 //use the scale and r values from the BLEPproperties array to compute the current state of each active BLEP and add it to the output value
2768 c->_f[j] += c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][1] * (step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].value + c->BLEPproperties[whichBLEP][0] * step_dd_table[c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP]].delta);
2769
2770 //increment the position in the BLEP table
2771 c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] += MINBLEP_PHASES;
2772 //check if this BLEP is finished and if so mark it as inactive so it isn't computed anymore.
2773 if (c->BLEPindices[whichBLEP] >= c->maxBLEPphase)
2774 {
2775 c->numBLEPs--;
2776 }
2777
2778 }
2779
2780
2781 z += 0.5f * (c->_f[j] - z); // LP filtering
2782 c->out = z;
2783 j = (j+1) & 7;
2784
2785 c->_p = p;
2786 c->_w = w;
2787 c->_b = b;
2788 c->_x = x;
2789 c->_z = z;
2790 c->_j = j;
2791 c->_k = k;
2792
2793 return -c->out * c->gain;
2794}
2795#ifdef ITCMRAM
2796void __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tMBSawPulse_setFreq(tMBSawPulse* const osc, Lfloat f)
2797#else
2798void tMBSawPulse_setFreq(tMBSawPulse const c, Lfloat f)
2799#endif
2800{
2801 c->freq = f;
2802 c->_w = c->freq * c->invSampleRate; /* phase increment */
2803 c->_inv_w = 1.0f / c->_w;
2804 if ((f > 6000.0f) || (f < -6000.0f))
2805 {
2806 c->active = 0;
2807 c->gain = 0.0f;
2808 }
2809 else
2810 {
2811 c->active = 1;
2812 c->gain = 1.0f;
2813 }
2814}
2815
2816#ifdef ITCMRAM
2817Lfloat __attribute__ ((section(".itcmram"))) __attribute__ ((aligned (32))) tMBSawPulse_sync(tMBSawPulse* const osc, Lfloat value)
2818#else
2819Lfloat tMBSawPulse_sync(tMBSawPulse const c, Lfloat value)
2820#endif
2821{
2822 //based on https://github.com/VCVRack/Fundamental/blob/5799ee2a9b21492b42ebcb9b65d5395ef5c1cbe2/src/VCO.cpp#L123
2823 Lfloat last = c->lastsyncin;
2824 Lfloat delta = value - last;
2825 Lfloat crossing = -last / delta;
2826 c->lastsyncin = value;
2827 if ((0.f < crossing) && (crossing <= 1.f) && (value >= 0.f))
2828 c->sync = (1.f - crossing) * delta;
2829 else c->sync = 0.f;
2830
2831 return value;
2832}

2868void tTable_initToPool(tTable* const cy, Lfloat* waveTable, int size, tMempool* const mp)
2869{

2872 c->mempool = m;
2873 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
2874
2875 c->waveTable = waveTable;

2889void tTable_setFreq(tTable const c, Lfloat freq)
2890{

2892
2893 c->freq = freq;
2894 c->inc = freq * c->invSampleRate;
2895 c->inc -= (int)c->inc;
2896}
2897
2898Lfloat tTable_tick(tTable const c)
2899{
2900 Lfloat temp;
2901 int intPart;
2902 Lfloat fracPart;
2903 Lfloat samp0;
2904 Lfloat samp1;
2905
2906 // Phasor increment
2907 c->phase += c->inc;
2908 if (c->phase >= 1.0f) c->phase -= 1.0f;
2909 if (c->phase < 0.0f) c->phase += 1.0f;
2910
2911 // Wavetable synthesis
2912
2913 temp = c->size * c->phase;
2914 intPart = (int)temp;
2915 fracPart = temp - (Lfloat)intPart;
2916 samp0 = c->waveTable[intPart];
2917 if (++intPart >= c->size) intPart = 0;
2918 samp1 = c->waveTable[intPart];
2919
2920 return (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * fracPart);
2921}

2929void tWaveTable_init(tWaveTable* const cy, Lfloat* table, int size, Lfloat maxFreq, LEAF* const leaf)
2930{
2931 tWaveTable_initToPool(cy, table, size, maxFreq, &leaf->mempool);
2932}
2933
2934void tWaveTable_initToPool(tWaveTable* const cy, Lfloat* table, int size, Lfloat maxFreq, tMempool* const mp)
2935{
2936 _tMempool* m = *mp;
2937 _tWaveTable* c = *cy = (_tWaveTable*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tWaveTable), m);
2938 c->mempool = m;
2939 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
2940
2941 c->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
2942
2943 c->maxFreq = maxFreq;
2944
2945 // Determine base frequency
2946 c->baseFreq = c->sampleRate / (Lfloat) size;
2947 c->invBaseFreq = 1.0f / c->baseFreq;
2948
2949 // Determine how many tables we need
2950 // Assume we need at least 2, the fundamental + one to account for setting extra anti aliasing
2951 c->numTables = 2;
2952 Lfloat f = c->baseFreq;
2953 while (f < c->maxFreq)
2954 {
2955 c->numTables++;
2956 f *= 2.0f; // pass this multiplier in to set spacing of tables? would need to change setFreq too
2957 }
2958
2959 c->size = size;
2960 c->sizeMask = size-1;
2961 // Allocate memory for the tables
2962 c->tables = (Lfloat**) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat*) * c->numTables, c->mempool);
2963 c->baseTable = (Lfloat*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat) * c->size, c->mempool);
2964 c->tables[0] = c->baseTable;
2965 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
2966 {
2967 c->tables[t] = (Lfloat*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat) * c->size, c->mempool);
2968 }
2969
2970 // Copy table
2971 for (int i = 0; i < c->size; ++i)
2972 {
2973 c->baseTable[i] = table[i];
2974 }
2975
2976 // Make bandlimited copies
2977 f = c->sampleRate * 0.25f; //start at half nyquist
2978 // Not worth going over order 8 I think, and even 8 is only marginally better than 4.
2979 tButterworth_initToPool(&c->bl, 8, -1.0f, f, mp);
2980 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
2981 {
2982 tButterworth_setF2(c->bl, f);
2983 // Do several passes here to prevent errors at the beginning of the waveform
2984 // Not sure how many passes to do, seem to need more as the filter cutoff goes down
2985 // 12 might be excessive but seems to work for now.
2986 for (int p = 0; p < LEAF_NUM_WAVETABLE_FILTER_PASSES; ++p)
2987 {
2988 for (int i = 0; i < c->size; ++i)
2989 {
2990 c->tables[t][i] = tButterworth_tick(c->bl, c->tables[t-1][i]);
2991 }
2992 }
2993 f *= 0.5f; //halve the cutoff for next pass
2994 }
2995 tButterworth_free(&c->bl);
2996}

2998void tWaveTable_free(tWaveTable* const cy)
2999{
3000 _tWaveTable* c = *cy;
3001
3002 mpool_free((char*)c->baseTable, c->mempool);
3003 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
3004 {
3005 mpool_free((char*)c->tables[t], c->mempool);
3006 }
3007 mpool_free((char*)c->tables, c->mempool);
3008 mpool_free((char*)c, c->mempool);
3009}
3010
3011void tWaveTable_setSampleRate(tWaveTable const c, Lfloat sr)
3012{
3013 // Changing the sample rate of a wavetable requires up to partially reinitialize
3014 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
3015 {
3016 mpool_free((char*)c->tables[t], c->mempool);
3017 }
3018 mpool_free((char*)c->tables, c->mempool);
3019
3020 c->sampleRate = sr;
3021
3022 // Determine base frequency
3023 c->baseFreq = c->sampleRate / (Lfloat) c->size;
3024 c->invBaseFreq = 1.0f / c->baseFreq;
3025
3026 // Determine how many tables we need
3027 // Assume we need at least 2, the fundamental + one to account for setting extra anti aliasing
3028 c->numTables = 2;
3029 Lfloat f = c->baseFreq;
3030 while (f < c->maxFreq)
3031 {
3032 c->numTables++;
3033 f *= 2.0f; // pass this multiplier in to set spacing of tables? would need to change setFreq too
3034 }
3035
3036 // Allocate memory for the tables
3037 c->tables = (Lfloat**) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat*) * c->numTables, c->mempool);
3038 c->tables[0] = c->baseTable;
3039 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
3040 {
3041 c->tables[t] = (Lfloat*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat) * c->size, c->mempool);
3042 }
3043
3044 // Make bandlimited copies
3045 f = c->sampleRate * 0.25f; //start at half nyquist
3046 // Not worth going over order 8 I think, and even 8 is only marginally better than 4.
3047 tButterworth_initToPool(&c->bl, 8, -1.0f, f, &c->mempool);
3048 tButterworth_setSampleRate(c->bl, c->sampleRate);
3049 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
3050 {
3051 tButterworth_setF2(c->bl, f);
3052 // Do several passes here to prevent errors at the beginning of the waveform
3053 // Not sure how many passes to do, seem to need more as the filter cutoff goes down
3054 // 12 might be excessive but seems to work for now.
3055 for (int p = 0; p < LEAF_NUM_WAVETABLE_FILTER_PASSES; ++p)
3056 {
3057 for (int i = 0; i < c->size; ++i)
3058 {
3059 c->tables[t][i] = tButterworth_tick(c->bl, c->tables[t-1][i]);
3060 }
3061 }
3062 f *= 0.5f; //halve the cutoff for next pass
3063 }
3064 tButterworth_free(&c->bl);
3065}

3111
3112Lfloat tWaveOsc_tick(tWaveOsc const c)
3113{
3114 // Phasor increment (unsigned 32bit int wraps automatically with overflow so no need for if branch checks, as you need with Lfloat)
3115 c->phase += c->inc;
3116 Lfloat LfloatPhase = (double)c->phase * 2.32830643654e-10;
3117 Lfloat s1 = 0.f, s2 = 0.f;
3118
3119 Lfloat temp;
3120 int idx;
3121 Lfloat frac;
3122 Lfloat samp0;
3123 Lfloat samp1;
3124
3125 int oct = c->oct;
3126
3127 int sizeMask = c->tables[c->o1]->sizeMask;
3128 Lfloat** tables = c->tables[c->o1]->tables;
3129
3130 // Wavetable synthesis
3131 temp = sizeMask * LfloatPhase;
3132 idx = (int)temp;
3133 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3134 samp0 = tables[oct][idx];
3135 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMask;
3136 samp1 = tables[oct][idx];
3137
3138 Lfloat oct0 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3139
3140 temp = sizeMask * LfloatPhase;
3141 idx = (int)temp;
3142 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3143 samp0 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3144 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMask;
3145 samp1 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3146
3147 Lfloat oct1 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3148
3149 s1 = oct0 + (oct1 - oct0) * c->w;
3150
3151 sizeMask = c->tables[c->o2]->sizeMask;
3152 tables = c->tables[c->o2]->tables;
3153
3154 // Wavetable synthesis
3155 temp = sizeMask * LfloatPhase;
3156 idx = (int)temp;
3157 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3158 samp0 = tables[oct][idx];
3159 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMask;
3160 samp1 = tables[oct][idx];
3161
3162 oct0 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3163
3164 temp = sizeMask * LfloatPhase;
3165 idx = (int)temp;
3166 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3167 samp0 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3168 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMask;
3169 samp1 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3170
3171 oct1 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3172
3173 s2 = oct0 + (oct1 - oct0) * c->w;
3174
3175 // Ideally should determine correlation to get a good equal power fade between tables
3176 return s1 + (s2 - s1) * c->mix;
3177}
3178
3179void tWaveOsc_setFreq(tWaveOsc const c, Lfloat freq)
3180{
3181 c->freq = freq;
3182
3183 c->inc = c->freq * c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32;
3184
3185 // abs for negative frequencies
3186 c->w = fabsf(c->freq * c->invBaseFreq);
3187
3188 // Probably ok to use a log2 approx here; won't effect tuning at all, just crossfading between octave tables
3189 // I bet we could turn this into a lookup and save a lot of processing
3190 c->w = log2f_approx(c->w) + c->aa;//+ LEAF_SQRT2 - 1.0f; adding an offset here will shift our table selection upward, reducing aliasing but lower high freq fidelity. +1.0f should remove all aliasing
3191 if (c->w < 0.0f) c->w = 0.0f; // If c->w is < 0.0f, then freq is less than our base freq
3192 c->oct = (int)c->w;
3193 c->w -= c->oct;
3194 if (c->oct >= c->numSubTables - 1) c->oct = c->numSubTables - 2;
3195}
3196
3197void tWaveOsc_setAntiAliasing(tWaveOsc const c, Lfloat aa)
3198{
3199 c->aa = aa;
3200}

3202void tWaveOsc_setIndex(tWaveOsc const c, Lfloat index)
3203{
3204 c->index = index;
3205 Lfloat f = c->index * (c->numTables - 1);
3206
3207 c->o1 = (int)f;
3208 c->o2 = c->o1 + 1;
3209 if (c->index >= 1.0f) c->o2 = c->o1;
3210 c->mix = f - c->o1;
3211}

3258void tWaveTableS_init(tWaveTableS* const cy, Lfloat* table, int size, Lfloat maxFreq, LEAF* const leaf)
3259{
3260 tWaveTableS_initToPool(cy, table, size, maxFreq, &leaf->mempool);
3261}
3262
3263void tWaveTableS_initToPool(tWaveTableS* const cy, Lfloat* table, int size, Lfloat maxFreq, tMempool* const mp)
3264{
3265 _tMempool* m = *mp;
3266 _tWaveTableS* c = *cy = (_tWaveTableS*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tWaveTableS), m);
3267 c->mempool = m;
3268 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
3269
3270 c->sampleRate = leaf->sampleRate;
3271
3272 c->maxFreq = maxFreq;
3273
3274 // Determine base frequency
3275 c->baseFreq = c->sampleRate / (Lfloat) size;
3276 c->invBaseFreq = 1.0f / c->baseFreq;
3277
3278 // Determine how many tables we need
3279 c->numTables = 2;
3280 Lfloat f = c->baseFreq;
3281 while (f < maxFreq)
3282 {
3283 c->numTables++;
3284 f *= 2.0f; // pass this multiplier in to set spacing of tables?
3285 }
3286
3287 // Allocate memory for the tables
3288 c->tables = (Lfloat**) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat*) * c->numTables, c->mempool);
3289 c->sizes = (int*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(int) * c->numTables, c->mempool);
3290 c->sizeMasks = (int*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(int) * c->numTables, c->mempool);
3291 c->sizes[0] = size;
3292 c->sizeMasks[0] = (c->sizes[0] - 1);
3293 c->baseTable = (Lfloat*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat) * c->sizes[0], c->mempool);
3294 c->tables[0] = c->baseTable;
3295 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
3296 {
3297 c->sizes[t] = c->sizes[t-1] / 2 > 128 ? c->sizes[t-1] / 2 : 128;
3298 c->sizeMasks[t] = (c->sizes[t] - 1);
3299 c->tables[t] = (Lfloat*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(Lfloat) * c->sizes[t], c->mempool);
3300 }
3301
3302 // Copy table
3303 for (int i = 0; i < c->sizes[0]; ++i)
3304 {
3305 c->baseTable[i] = table[i];
3306 }
3307
3308 // Make bandlimited copies
3309 f = c->sampleRate * 0.25; //start at half nyquist
3310 // Not worth going over order 8 I think, and even 8 is only marginally better than 4.
3311 tButterworth_initToPool(&c->bl, 8, -1.0f, f, mp);
3312 tOversampler_initToPool(&c->ds, 2, 1, mp);
3313 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
3314 {
3315 // Size is going down; we need to downsample
3316 if (c->sizes[t] < c->sizes[t-1])
3317 {
3318 // Similar to tWaveTable, doing multiple passes here helps, but not sure what number is optimal
3319 for (int p = 0; p < LEAF_NUM_WAVETABLE_FILTER_PASSES; ++p)
3320 {
3321 for (int i = 0; i < c->sizes[t]; ++i)
3322 {
3323 c->dsBuffer[0] = tButterworth_tick(c->bl, c->tables[t-1][i*2]);
3324 c->dsBuffer[1] = tButterworth_tick(c->bl, c->tables[t-1][(i*2)+1]);
3325 c->tables[t][i] = tOversampler_downsample(c->ds, c->dsBuffer);
3326 }
3327 }
3328 }
3329 else
3330 {
3331 tButterworth_setF2(c->bl, f);
3332 for (int p = 0; p < LEAF_NUM_WAVETABLE_FILTER_PASSES; ++p)
3333 {
3334 for (int i = 0; i < c->sizes[t]; ++i)
3335 {
3336 c->tables[t][i] = tButterworth_tick(c->bl, c->tables[t-1][i]);
3337 }
3338 }
3339 f *= 0.5f; //halve the cutoff for next pass
3340 }
3341 }
3342 tOversampler_free(&c->ds);
3343 tButterworth_free(&c->bl);
3344}
3345
3346void tWaveTableS_free(tWaveTableS* const cy)
3347{
3348 _tWaveTableS* c = *cy;
3349
3350 mpool_free((char*)c->baseTable, c->mempool);
3351 for (int t = 1; t < c->numTables; ++t)
3352 {
3353 mpool_free((char*)c->tables[t], c->mempool);
3354 }
3355 mpool_free((char*)c->tables, c->mempool);
3356 mpool_free((char*)c->sizes, c->mempool);
3357 mpool_free((char*)c->sizeMasks, c->mempool);
3358 mpool_free((char*)c, c->mempool);
3359}

3487Lfloat tWaveOscS_tick(tWaveOscS const c)
3488{
3489 // Phasor increment (unsigned 32bit int wraps automatically with overflow so no need for if branch checks, as you need with Lfloat)
3490 c->phase += c->inc;
3491 Lfloat LfloatPhase = (double)c->phase * 2.32830643654e-10;
3492 Lfloat s1 = 0.f, s2 = 0.f;
3493
3494 Lfloat temp;
3495 int idx;
3496 Lfloat frac;
3497 Lfloat samp0;
3498 Lfloat samp1;
3499
3500 int oct = c->oct;
3501
3502 Lfloat** tables = c->tables[c->o1]->tables;
3503 int* sizes = c->tables[c->o1]->sizes;
3504 int* sizeMasks = c->tables[c->o1]->sizeMasks;
3505
3506 // Wavetable synthesis
3507 temp = sizes[oct] * LfloatPhase;
3508 idx = (int)temp;
3509 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3510 samp0 = tables[oct][idx];
3511 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMasks[oct];
3512 samp1 = tables[oct][idx];
3513
3514 Lfloat oct0 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3515
3516 temp = sizes[oct+1] * LfloatPhase;
3517 idx = (int)temp;
3518 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3519 samp0 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3520 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMasks[oct+1];
3521 samp1 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3522
3523 Lfloat oct1 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3524
3525 s1 = oct0 + (oct1 - oct0) * c->w;
3526
3527 tables = c->tables[c->o2]->tables;
3528 sizes = c->tables[c->o2]->sizes;
3529 sizeMasks = c->tables[c->o2]->sizeMasks;
3530
3531 // Wavetable synthesis
3532 temp = sizes[oct] * LfloatPhase;
3533 idx = (int)temp;
3534 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3535 samp0 = tables[oct][idx];
3536 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMasks[oct];
3537 samp1 = tables[oct][idx];
3538
3539 oct0 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3540
3541 temp = sizes[oct+1] * LfloatPhase;
3542 idx = (int)temp;
3543 frac = temp - (Lfloat)idx;
3544 samp0 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3545 idx = (idx + 1) & sizeMasks[oct+1];
3546 samp1 = tables[oct+1][idx];
3547
3548 oct1 = (samp0 + (samp1 - samp0) * frac);
3549
3550 s2 = oct0 + (oct1 - oct0) * c->w;
3551
3552 // Ideally should determine correlation to get a good equal power fade between tables
3553 return s1 + (s2 - s1) * c->mix;
3554}

3556void tWaveOscS_setFreq(tWaveOscS const c, Lfloat freq)
3557{

3560 c->inc = c->freq * c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32;
3561
3562 // abs for negative frequencies
3563 c->w = fabsf(c->freq * c->invBaseFreq);
3564
3565 // Probably ok to use a log2 approx here; won't effect tuning at all, just crossfading between octave tables
3566 // I bet we could turn this into a lookup and save a lot of processing
3567 c->w = log2f_approx(c->w) + c->aa;//+ LEAF_SQRT2 - 1.0f; adding an offset here will shift our table selection upward, reducing aliasing but lower high freq fidelity. +1.0f should remove all aliasing
3568 if (c->w < 0.0f) c->w = 0.0f; // If c->w is < 0.0f, then freq is less than our base freq
3569 c->oct = (int)c->w;
3570 c->w -= c->oct;
3571 if (c->oct >= c->numSubTables - 1) c->oct = c->numSubTables - 2;
3572}

3831{

3834 //bitmask fun
3835 int32_t shiftedPhase = c->phase + 1073741824; // offset by 1/4" wave by adding 2^30 to get things in phase with the other LFO oscillators
3836 uint32_t mask = shiftedPhase >> 31; //get the sign bit
3837 shiftedPhase = shiftedPhase + mask; // add 1 if negative, zero if positive, to balance
3838 shiftedPhase = shiftedPhase ^ mask; //invert the value to get absolute value of integer
3839 Lfloat output = (((Lfloat)shiftedPhase * INV_TWO_TO_31) - 0.5f) * 2.0f; //scale it to -1.0f to 1.0f Lfloat
3840 return output;
3841
3842}

3926 void tDampedOscillator_initToPool (tDampedOscillator* const cy, tMempool* const mp)

3930 c->mempool = m;

3932
3933
3934 c->freq_ = 0.0f;
3935 c->decay_ = 1.0f;
3936
3937 tDampedOscillator_setSampleRate(*cy, leaf->sampleRate);
3938 c->loop_gain_ = cosf(c->freq_ * c->two_pi_by_sample_rate_);
3939 Lfloat g = sqrtf((1.0f - c->loop_gain_) / (1.0f + c->loop_gain_));
3940 c->turns_ratio_ = g;

3951 Lfloat tDampedOscillator_tick (tDampedOscillator const c)
3952 {
3953 Lfloat w = c->decay_ * c->x_;
3954 Lfloat z = c->loop_gain_ * (c->y_ + w);
3955 c->x_ = z - c->y_;
3956 c->y_ = z + w;
3957 return c->y_;
3958 }
3959 void tDampedOscillator_setFreq (tDampedOscillator const c, Lfloat freq_hz)
3960 {
3961 c->freq_ = freq_hz;
3962
3963#ifdef ARM_MATH_CM7
3964 c->loop_gain_ = arm_cos_f32(freq_hz * c->two_pi_by_sample_rate_);
3965 Lfloat g = 1.0f;
3966 arm_sqrt_f32((1.0f - c->loop_gain_) / (1.0f + c->loop_gain_), &g);
3967#else
3968 c->loop_gain_ = cosf(freq_hz * c->two_pi_by_sample_rate_);
3969 Lfloat g = sqrtf((1.0f - c->loop_gain_) / (1.0f + c->loop_gain_));
3970#endif
3971 // scale state variable in preparation for the next step
3972 c->x_ *= g / c->turns_ratio_;
3973 c->turns_ratio_ = g;
3974
3975 }

3981
3982
3983 c->decay_ = r * r;
3984
3985 }

4000void tPlutaQuadOsc_init(tPlutaQuadOsc* const cy, uint32_t const oversamplingRatio, LEAF* const leaf)
4001{
4002 tPlutaQuadOsc_initToPool(cy, oversamplingRatio, &leaf->mempool);
4003}
4004
4005void tPlutaQuadOsc_initToPool (tPlutaQuadOsc* const cy, uint32_t const oversamplingRatio, tMempool* const mp)
4006{
4007 _tMempool* m = *mp;
4008 _tPlutaQuadOsc* c = *cy = (_tPlutaQuadOsc*) mpool_alloc(sizeof(_tPlutaQuadOsc), m);
4009 c->mempool = m;
4010 LEAF* leaf = c->mempool->leaf;
4011 c->oversamplingRatio = oversamplingRatio;
4012 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
4013 {
4014 c->inc[i] = 0;
4015 c->phase[i] = 0;
4016 c->biPolarOutputs[i] = 0.0f;
4017 c->freq[i] = 0.0f;
4018 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
4019 {
4020 c->fmMatrix[i][j] = 0.0f;
4021 }
4022 c->outputAmplitudes[i] = 1.0f;
4023 }
4024 Lfloat oversampledSamplingRate = (leaf->sampleRate * c->oversamplingRatio);
4025
4026 Lfloat nyquistFreq = leaf->sampleRate * 0.47f; //nyquist of main leaf sample rate (filter will drop it down to this)
4027
4028 //set up the lowpass for the decimation.
4029 //butterworth lowpass - would be better to create a butterworth object that is lowpass only and uses tSVFtickLP for efficiency
4030 tButterworth_initToPool(&c->lowpass, 8, 0.0f, nyquistFreq, mp);
4031 //correct samplerate to take into account oversampling
4032 tButterworth_setSampleRate (c->lowpass, oversampledSamplingRate);
4033 //now reset the frequencies with new samplerate
4034 tButterworth_setF2 (c->lowpass, nyquistFreq);
4035
4036 Lfloat invSampleRate = 1.0 / oversampledSamplingRate;
4037 c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32 = (invSampleRate * TWO_TO_32);
4038 for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
4039 {
4040 tPlutaQuadOsc_setFreq(*cy, i, 220.0f);
4041 }
4042}
4043
4044Lfloat tPlutaQuadOsc_tick (tPlutaQuadOsc const c)
4045{
4046 Lfloat outputSample = 0.0f;
4047 for (int i = 0; i < c->oversamplingRatio; i++)
4048 {
4049 Lfloat currentSample = 0.0f;
4050 for (int j =0; j < 4; j++)
4051 {
4052 //apply freq modulation
4053 Lfloat freqModSum = c->biPolarOutputs[0] * c->fmMatrix[i][0] + c->biPolarOutputs[1] * c->fmMatrix[i][1]+ c->biPolarOutputs[2] * c->fmMatrix[i][2] + c->biPolarOutputs[3] * c->fmMatrix[i][3];
4054
4055 uint32_t tempInc = c->inc[i] + (uint32_t)(freqModSum * c->invSampleRateTimesTwoTo32);
4056 //increment oscillator
4057 c->phase[j] += tempInc;
4058
4059 //get output and add to mix
4060 // this version is sawtooth, could be sine or triangle or square too
4061 Lfloat out = (c->phase[j] * INV_TWO_TO_32 * 2.0f) - 1.0f;
4062 c->biPolarOutputs[i] = out;
4063 currentSample += out * c->outputAmplitudes[i];
4064 }
4065 outputSample = tButterworth_tick(c->lowpass, currentSample); //lowpass before decimation
4066 }
4067 //only last sample of the oversampled buffer gets used (decimation step)
4068 return outputSample * 0.249f;
4069}
4070
4071void tPlutaQuadOsc_setFreq (tPlutaQuadOsc const c, uint32_t const whichOsc, Lfloat const freq)
4072{
